title: PDI NoVap static conductivity qualification
scope: source-authoritative NoVap route for PDI8_REFERENCE and PDI10_BIMODAL
selection_rule: Choose the loosest K limit that satisfies total NoVap K abs(logK)<=1e-3 for both preregistered PDI sets on dense validation. Do not alter retention gates.
decision_rule: If a qualified static K representation exists, proceed to a controlled NoVap Richards matrix. Vapor-enabled PDI remains blocked regardless of this result.
